narrative.i_can: reset my password using my email address
narrative.so_that: I can regain access to my account if I forget my password

acceptance_criteria.description: Happy path: password reset email is sent
acceptance_criteria.given: the customer is on the forgot password page
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer enters their registered email address and submits
acceptance_criteria.then: a password reset email is sent and the customer sees a confirmation message
